# Supply — Altium 365 API
> Parts, offers, part families, reference designs, evaluation kits, software projects and solution templates.

Concepts: [supply](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/cdm/subsets/supply/). Schema slice: [schema.graphql](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/schema.graphql) (~29331 tokens). Overview: [overview](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/overview.md).

## Entities
- [SupEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-eval-kit.md): Evaluation Kit — A vendor evaluation kit in the supply catalog, described by its associated devices, its reference designs (including a main one) and the software projects compatible with it. GRID `grid:supply::platform:eval-kit/{id}`. Via: supEvalKitById, supEvalKitsByIds, supEvalKitDetailsByRefDesignId, supEvalKits, supEvalKitSearch, …
- [SupPartFamily](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-family.md): Part Family — A manufacturer's grouping of parts in the supply data, where the kind of family is vendor-specific (e.g. Series or Family). GRID `grid:supply::platform:part-family/{id}`. Via: SupPartGroup.parent
- [SupPartGroup](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-part-group.md): Part Group — A leaf of the part family hierarchy in the supply data, holding the parts that belong to it together with group-level information such as its manufacturer, overview, key features and documents. GRID `grid:supply::platform:part-group/{id}`. Via: supPartGroupById, supPartGroupsByIds, supPartGroupByPartId, SupPartFamily.partGroups
- [SupRefDesign](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-ref-design.md): Reference Design — An example design published in the supply catalog, bringing together its design files (e.g. schematics and layouts), documentation and the parts it uses. GRID `grid:supply::platform:ref-design/{id}`. Via: supRefDesignById, supRefDesignsByIds, supRefDesignByName, SupEvalKit.mainRefDesign, SupEvalKit.refDesigns, …
- [SupSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-software-project.md): Software Project — A software project published in the supply catalog, together with the evaluation kits it is compatible with. GRID `grid:supply::platform:software-project/{id}`. Via: supSoftwareProjectById, supSoftwareProjectsByIds, supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectsByEvalKitId, supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectSearch, supSoftwareProjects, …
- [SupSolutionTemplate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/types/objects/sup-solution-template.md): Solution Template — A publisher's template for a solution, held in the supply catalog. GRID `grid:supply::platform:solution-template/{id}`. Via: supSolutionTemplateById, supSolutionTemplatesByIds, supSolutionTemplateByName, supSolutionTemplates, supSolutionTemplatesByApplicationId, …

## Entry points
- [supEvalKitById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-by-id.md): Search a specific evaluation kit by its unique identifier.
- [supEvalKitsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kits-by-ids.md): Search a specific evaluation kit by its unique identifier.
- [supPartGroupById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-id.md): Get a specific part group by its unique identifier (GRID).
- [supPartGroupsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-part-groups-by-ids.md): Get a set of part groups by their unique identifiers (GRIDs).
- [supRefDesignById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-ref-design-by-id.md): Search a specific reference design by its unique identifier.
- [supRefDesignsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-ref-designs-by-ids.md): Search a specific reference designs by its unique identifiers.
- [supSoftwareProjectById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-by-id.md): Search a specific software project by its unique identifier.
- [supSoftwareProjectsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-projects-by-ids.md): Search a specific software project by its unique identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateApplicationById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-application-by-id.md): Search a specific solution template by its unique identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-by-id.md): Search a specific solution template by its unique identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplatesByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates-by-ids.md): Search a specific solution template by its unique identifier.
- [supEvalKitDetailsByRefDesignId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-details-by-ref-design-id.md) (list): The evaluation kits of reference design.
- [supEvalKits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kits.md) (list): List a evaluation kits.
- [supEvalKitSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-search.md) (list): Searches evaluation kits.
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectsByEvalKitId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-projects-by-eval-kit-id.md) (list): Get evaluation kit compatible software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-search.md) (list): Searches evauation kit compatible software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjects](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-projects.md) (list): List a reference solutions.
- [supSoftwareProjectSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-search.md) (list): Searches software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsBySolutionTemplateId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-by-solution-template-id.md) (list): Get software projects associated with a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplates](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates.md) (list): List a solution templates.
- [supSolutionTemplatesByApplicationId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-templates-by-application-id.md) (list): Search a specific solution template by application identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-search.md) (list): Searches solution templates.

## Queries
- [supEvalKitParameterInfos](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-parameter-infos.md): List all available evaluation kit parameter definitions.
- [supEvalKitSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitBySoftwareProjectIdAndEvalKitId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-software-project-compatible-eval-kit-by-software-project-id-and-eval-kit-id.md): The evaluation kit source associated with the software project.
- [supEvalKitSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitsBySoftwareProjectId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-software-project-compatible-eval-kits-by-software-project-id.md): The list of evaluation kit sources associated with the software project.
- [supEvalKitSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKitSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-eval-kit-software-project-compatible-eval-kit-search.md): Searches evauation kit compatible software projects.
- [supPartGroupByPartId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-part-group-by-part-id.md): Get a part group by the ID of the part.
- [supRefDesignByName](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-ref-design-by-name.md): Search a specific reference design by its unique name.
- [supRefDesigns](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-ref-designs.md): Search a reference designs.
- [supRefParts](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-ref-parts.md): Search a specific parts by reference design unique identifier and part's designators.
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectIdsByEvalKitId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-ids-by-eval-kit-id.md): Get evaluation kit compatible software project idenfitiers.
- [supSoftwareProjectParameterInfos](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-parameter-infos.md): List all available software project parameter definitions.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectIdsBySolutionTemplateId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-project-ids-by-solution-template-id.md): Get software project identifiers associated with a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsBySolutionTemplateIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-by-solution-template-ids.md): Get software projects associated with multiple solution templates, grouped by solution template identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateApplicationByApplicationId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-application-by-application-id.md): Search a specific solution template by its application identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateApplications](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-applications.md): List a solution template applications.
- [supSolutionTemplateApplicationsSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-applications-search.md): Searches solution template applications.
- [supSolutionTemplateByName](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-by-name.md): Search a specific solution template by its unique stable name identifier.
- [supSolutionTemplateRefDesignSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/queries/sup-solution-template-ref-design-search.md): Search solution templates and reference designs.

## Mutations
- [supEvalKitAddDevices](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-add-devices.md): Add devices to an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitAddPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-add-preview-images.md): Add preview images to an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitAddRefDesignCompatibleEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-add-ref-design-compatible-eval-kit.md): Add evaluation kits to a reference design.
- [supEvalKitCreateEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-create-eval-kit.md): Create a new evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitDeleteDevices](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-delete-devices.md): Delete devices from an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitDeleteEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-delete-eval-kit.md): Delete a evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitDeletePreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-delete-preview-images.md): Delete preview images from an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitDeleteRefDesignCompatibleEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-delete-ref-design-compatible-eval-kit.md): Delete evaluation kits from a reference design.
- [supEvalKitPatchParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-patch-parameters.md): Add or remove parameters on an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitSetMainRefDesign](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-set-main-ref-design.md): Set the main reference design for an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitSetParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-set-parameters.md): Replace all parameters on an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitSoftwareProjectCompatibleEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-software-project-compatible-eval-kit.md): Modify a software project compatible evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitSortPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-sort-preview-images.md): Sort preview images of an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitUnsetMainRefDesign](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-unset-main-ref-design.md): Unset a specific main reference design for an evaluation kit.
- [supEvalKitUpdateEvalKit](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-eval-kit-update-eval-kit.md): Update a evaluation kit.
- [supSoftwareProjectCreateSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-create-software-project.md): Create a new software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectDeleteSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-delete-software-project.md): Delete a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-parameters.md): Add or remove parameters on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-preview-images.md): Patch preview images on a software project: add, delete, or reorder.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplates](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-software-project-solution-templates.md): Add or remove software project associations on a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-parameters.md): Replace all parameters on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-preview-images.md): Replace all preview images on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplates](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-software-project-solution-templates.md): Replace all software project associations on a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectUpdateEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-update-eval-kit-compatible-software-project.md): Update evaluation kit's compatible software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectUpdateSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-update-software-project.md): Update a software project.
- [supSolutionTemplateCreateSolutionTemplate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-create-solution-template.md): Create a new solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateCreateSolutionTemplateApplication](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-create-solution-template-application.md): Create a new solution template application.
- [supSolutionTemplateDeleteSolutionTemplate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-delete-solution-template.md): Delete a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateDeleteSolutionTemplateApplication](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-delete-solution-template-application.md): Delete a solution template application.
- [supSolutionTemplateIndexSolutionTemplate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-index-solution-template.md): Index list of solution templates by identifiers.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchCompatibleEvalKits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-compatible-eval-kits.md): Add, update or remove individual compatible eval kits on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchEsdSource](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-esd-source.md): Patch the ESD source of a solution template: upload, replace, or clear individual files.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchKeyFeatureGroups](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-key-feature-groups.md): Add or remove list of key feature groups related to a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-parameters.md): Add, update, or remove individual parameters on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-preview-images.md): Patch preview images on a solution template: add, delete, or reorder.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchRefDesigns](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-ref-designs.md): Add or remove individual reference designs on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplatePatchTags](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-patch-tags.md): Add or remove list of tags related to a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetCompatibleEvalKits](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-compatible-eval-kits.md): Replace all compatible eval kits on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetKeyFeatureGroups](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-key-feature-groups.md): Replace existing list of key feature groups by new one related to a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-parameters.md): Replace all parameters on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-preview-images.md): Replace all preview images on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetRefDesigns](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-ref-designs.md): Replace all reference designs on a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateSetTags](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-set-tags.md): Replace existing list of tags by new one related to a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateUpdateSolutionTemplate](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-update-solution-template.md): Update a solution template.
- [supSolutionTemplateUpdateSolutionTemplateApplication](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-update-solution-template-application.md): Update a new solution template application.
- [supSolutionTemplateUpdateSolutionTemplateStatus](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/supply/operations/mutations/sup-solution-template-update-solution-template-status.md): Update the status of a solution template.
